# dikacore.dev

> Personal site of Fransiskus Andika Setiawan (Dika) — Software Developer in Test (SDET) and QA Core Enabler at Stockbit. Builds test infrastructure, Appium device farms, AI-driven flaky-test detection, self-healing locators, and CI/CD pipelines for iOS, Android, Web, Desktop, and API.

## About

- **Name:** Fransiskus Andika Setiawan (also: Dika, dikako, dikakoko, dikacore)
- **Role:** Sr. QA Engineer / QA Core Enabler at Stockbit (Jan 2022 – present)
- **Location:** Indonesia
- **Specialties:** Test Automation, Appium Device Farm, Self-healing locators, AI for QA, Flaky-test detection, Mobile + Web + Desktop + API automation, Security testing with Frida, CI/CD pipelines.

## Stack

- **Languages:** Java, Ruby, Go, JavaScript / TypeScript, Python, Swift, Kotlin, PHP
- **Automation:** Cucumber, TestNG, RSpec, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, Selenium, WebdriverIO, Postman / Newman, K6
- **Infra:** Docker, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Grafana, BrowserStack, Appium Device Farm, Mac Stadium, Genymotion
- **Coverage:** REST, gRPC, WebSocket, Web, Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Database, Redis, Kafka

## Selected packages

- `appium-locator-healer` — self-healing locators for Appium (JitPack).
- `gdrive-downloader` — utility to download files from Google Drive (JitPack).
- Cucumber Runner — VS Code extension to run/debug `.feature` scenarios with play buttons.
